sources.title: LoRA Fine-tuning | QwenLM/Qwen | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: LoRA allows you to fine-tune large language models with significantly fewer trainable parameters than full fine-tuning, resulting in faster training, reduced memory requirements, and smaller adapter checkpoints.
